text: Scholarship Policy According to the strategy cooperation agreement between SICAS and University of Jinan, the students who get admission in this major through SICAS only have to pay CNY16,000/Year instead of CNY 24,000 /Year every year start from the second year . The first year is not included. The scholarship will directly to reduce the tuition, not cash. Special Scholarship for SICAS International Students in University of Jinan (click to apply)
